reason: The annex was introduced from previously audited byte bindings. The checked-in verifier recomputes those bytes in a full repository checkout. Execution MPT/receipt and beacon finality proof objects are not yet carried by v1 and therefore cannot be marked PASS.
non_claims: No claim that RPC JSON alone proves execution inclusion.
No claim that an explorer timestamp is an absolute Earth-time notarization.
No claim that Ethereum changes or supplements the three Bitcoin Originals as Canon.
